name: Quiñenco S.A.
note: Chilean conglomerate listed on the Santiago exchange, part of the Luksic group. Its own page states Quiñenco controls Banco de Chile through LQ Inversiones Financieras S.A. (LQIF), held 50/50 with Citigroup, and LQIF held 51.2% of the voting and economic rights in Banco de Chile at 31 December 2025.
